# Typography

Acuity sets body text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next [@AtkinsonHyperlegibleFont2019], a typeface designed by the Braille Institute for maximum legibility. Headings use EB Garamond for typographic contrast, and code is set in JetBrains Mono. All three load from Google Fonts.

# Color Palette

[Paul Tol's color palette](https://sronpersonalpages.nl/~pault/), designed to remain distinguishable under color-blindness, provides the named swatches.

![The palette, read from `_brand.yml`.](figures/palette.fig.js){#fig-palette .column-margin}

Text on a swatch is set in black or white by how light the color is (@fig-lightness).

![Lightness of each color. Text on a color right of the line is set in black.](figures/lightness.fig.js){#fig-lightness}

Semantic roles — primary, success, warning, danger — are mapped separately in `_brand.yml` and drive callout colors and link accents:

::: {.callout-note}
**Note** — primary `{{< brand color primary >}}`
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
**Success** — green `{{< brand color green >}}`
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
**Warning** — sand `{{< brand color sand >}}`
:::

::: {.callout-important}
**Danger** — wine `{{< brand color wine >}}`
:::

# Figures

A figure takes the width of its column, or a share of it with `width`. The shared configuration in `_extension.yml` sets its default aspect ratio and the small text size used by figures, legends, notes, and captions in both outputs (@fig-series). Individual figures can override their height when their content needs a different shape.

![Three invented series.](figures/series.fig.js){#fig-series}

![An invented intensity across the whole page.](figures/intensity.fig.js){#fig-intensity .column-page-right}

A legend is drawn above the marks of its figure: swatches for groups (@fig-groups, @fig-symbol), and a ramp for a continuous scale (@fig-sequential, @fig-diverging, @fig-opacity) or for bands (@fig-threshold). A figure without one keeps all its height for the marks (@fig-histogram).

![An invented normal sample.](figures/histogram.fig.js){#fig-histogram}

![Three invented groups.](figures/groups.fig.js){#fig-groups}

![Distance from the centre, as a sequential colour.](figures/sequential.fig.js){#fig-sequential .column-margin}

![The product of the coordinates, as a diverging colour.](figures/diverging.fig.js){#fig-diverging width="60%"}

![Distance from the centre, in bands.](figures/threshold.fig.js){#fig-threshold}

![The groups, as symbols.](figures/symbol.fig.js){#fig-symbol}

![Distance from the vertical axis, as opacity.](figures/opacity.fig.js){#fig-opacity}


```{ojs}
Plot.rectY({length: 1000}, Plot.binX({y: "count"}, {x: d3.randomNormal()})).plot()
```
